properties.description: site/index.html explains what reflow2 is as a project brain, in drawings, through a made-up school robotics team (where knowledge lives; what goes in; one brain across repositories; troubleshooting, designing something new, a requirement change; the loop). site/setup.html gives three complete setup paths: your own computer (install.sh, then /genesis, /adopt or /where in an MCP agent), VS Code where an organisation blocks third-party MCP (reflow2 init --harness vscode-cli, the read auto-approve rule, the hooks, upgrading), and a server for a team (the container image by digest, the volume, probes, one writer per store, bearer-token sign-in, upgrading). Both are in flo2.io's dark layout. .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes site/ to GitHub Pages on every push to main that touches it. LIVE since 2026-10-06 (#689 merged at 69a23912; Pages source set to GitHub Actions on the owner's word; the first deploy ran green). Both pages answered 200 from outside.
properties.name: reflow2's site explains what reflow2 is and publishes its setup paths, at flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2
